image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting in a natural environment with dry twigs and soil. The rabbit is facing right, displaying its greyish-brown fur, large dark eye, upright ears with dark tips, and a fluffy white tail. The lighting is bright, casting shadows on the ground.
